profiles.description: Owns enterprise learning strategy and role-based capability development across the HR Talent, PMO, and Talent & Workforce Management value streams. Leads training needs analysis by impacted role, designs role-based curricula and materials, and validates curriculum design with sponsors for sign-off before delivery. Delivers training, tracks completion and feedback, and assigns and monitors mandatory compliance training for new hires and 90-day role ramps. Also curates the lessons-learned knowledge repository, distilling recurring lessons into reusable delivery guidance, and builds development plans to close successor-readiness gaps identified in succession planning. Approves training plans, curriculum updates, and learning investment priorities as the governance point for training across the carrier.

profiles.description: Staff attorney in Commercial Legal who leads the contract lifecycle for the Legal Corporate Governance value stream: drafting contract terms from business requirements, tailoring non-standard clauses against the negotiation playbook, quality-checking drafts, conducting negotiation rounds, and locking final agreed text. Also owns legal advisory intake for the business — triaging requests by subject area and urgency, confirming scope with requesters, and identifying controlling statutes, regulations, and case law for research memoranda and opinions. Manages amendments and assignments to executed agreements and supports employment-law advisory, pre-litigation dispute handling, and legal training for business units. Advises on new products and marketing materials and supports litigation holds and discovery when matters escalate.

profiles.notes: Priors (Legal / Individual Contributor) confirmed: Streamline's seniority ladder places 'Counsel' as a non-managing attorney handling contracts and business-unit advisory, matching the packet's owner tasks.

profiles.description: Runs the operational machinery of the legal department for the Legal Corporate Governance value stream: capturing and classifying contract requests, verifying intake completeness against checklists, and routing contracts for internal approvals per the delegation-of-authority matrix. Owns contract obligation monitoring — extracting key obligations, milestones, and renewal dates from executed contracts and issuing compliance reminders — plus advisory matter intake and matter numbering. Administers the outside counsel program end to end: engaging counsel, setting matter budgets and billing guidelines, reviewing invoices against guidelines, and monitoring performance and spend. Also maintains governance records and supports litigation intake, legal holds, and portfolio-level legal reporting, blending classic legal-operations workflow orchestration with corporate paralegal execution.

O*NET 23-2011.00 - Paralegals and Legal Assistants

classificationFlags.item: Select And Engage Outside Counsel For The Contract Matter

profiles.notes: Hybrid title is a deliberate stretch across two benchmarks: Brightflag's Legal Operations Manager (budget/tech/outside-counsel admin) and O*NET Paralegals (document and matter support). 'Manager' level follows the title and Brightflag's placement between specialist and director; the role owns processes more than people.

profiles.description: Provides administrative and secretarial support to legal leadership within the Legal Corporate Governance value stream, owning regulatory correspondence and secretarial filings — submitting filings and capturing proof of acceptance — and the notarial services function: verifying signer identity and authority, executing notarial acts and affixing the seal, and recording each act in the sequential journal of record. Manages attorney calendars, court deadlines, and statute-of-limitations docketing; prepares, proofreads, and formats correspondence, pleadings, and board materials; and maintains matter files, privilege markings, and records retention. Participates across the wider legal workflow, supporting advisory intake logging, opinion issuance, litigation intake triage, and outside counsel invoice routing.

profiles.description: Handles bodily injury and liability claims end to end in the Claims value stream: preparing witness interview outlines, taking and filing recorded statements, reconstructing the sequence of events from evidence, applying jurisdictional negligence rules, and allocating percentage fault across parties. Calculates injury claim value and special damages, identifies settling parties, liens, and consent requirements, and analyzes claimant demand packages against valuation to negotiate settlements within authority. Sets reserves, documents coverage positions, and drafts reservation-of-rights and denial letters with claims counsel input. When suits are filed, logs served summonses against the underlying claim file, calendars answer deadlines and statutory response dates, and coordinates defense counsel, experts, and independent adjusters on litigated files.

profiles.description: Adjudicates life and annuity death claims across the Claims and Life & Annuity Claims value streams, owning the process from notification intake — capturing decedent and policy details, matching notifications to in-force policies, setting up claim files, and issuing beneficiary acknowledgments — through good-order management with beneficiary-specific requirements checklists and follow-up. Conducts contestability review: determining whether death falls within the contestability period, ordering and reviewing application and medical records for material misrepresentation, and identifying competing claimants for interpleader referral. Calculates death benefits and statutory interest including loans, liens, and riders; processes accelerated death benefit and rider claims, settlement option elections, and annuity death benefit and maturity transactions; and administers retained asset accounts and unclaimed property obligations.

profiles.description: Front-line service role in Policy Operations supporting the Life Policy Administration & Inforce Servicing value stream. Processes beneficiary, ownership, and address changes on in-force life policies, handles policy loans, partial surrenders, and dividend option changes, and processes premium mode changes, reinstatements, and lapse-prevention outreach. Responds to policyholder and agent inquiries on values, coverage, and billing, verifying caller identity and authority before releasing information or executing transactions. Generates in-force illustrations and annual policy statements on request. The packet defines this role through responsibilities only (no graph tasks or deliverables yet), consistent with a transactional service desk supporting the policy-administration process rather than owning process steps.

Wiring this role's tasks into the graph is an open gap.

profiles.description: Assesses mortality and morbidity risk on new life business in the Life New Business & Underwriting value stream. Evaluates medical, financial, and lifestyle evidence; orders and interprets APS records, labs, MIB results, and prescription histories; and assigns rate classes, table ratings, exclusions, or declinations per underwriting guidelines. Documents underwriting rationale and evidence supporting each risk decision, refers cases exceeding authority limits to senior underwriters or reinsurers with recommendations, and applies facultative and automatic reinsurance treaty requirements to large or substandard cases. Sits in Field Underwriting and operates as the carrier's individual risk-selection decision point for life products.

profiles.description: In-house attorney who leads litigation management for the Legal Corporate Governance value stream and supports Claims on litigated files. Owns litigation intake — triaging complaints and summonses for jurisdiction and answer deadline, assigning defense counsel, and issuing engagement instructions — plus legal hold scoping across custodians and data sources. Develops case assessments and recommended defense theories, runs periodic case status reviews with defense counsel, evaluates settlement posture and recommends authority ranges, prepares mediation position statements and ADR submissions, and drafts and finalizes settlement and release agreements. Closes matters with lessons-learned capture into the litigation playbook and also covers reinsurance disputes/arbitration and intellectual property matters.

profiles.description: Oversees the carrier's portfolio of litigated matters from the Coverage & Litigation department, ensuring cases progress consistently with claims and legal strategy. Monitors case plans, defense counsel performance, budgets, and outcomes; controls legal spend; and directs defense strategy on litigated files. Escalates material developments, settlement decisions, and trial-readiness issues to legal and claims leadership, and coordinates litigation oversight reporting across stakeholders. The packet ties the role to Enterprise Strategy & Portfolio Management in a Support relation, positioning it as a governance and oversight layer over litigation rather than a hands-on case-handling desk.

profiles.notes: Packet has zero wired tasks/deliverables; profile rests on responsibilities. Sits adjacent to Litigation Counsel; distinct in owning oversight/reporting vs matter handling.

profiles.description: Actuarial analyst in the Reserving department who builds the quantitative foundation for the carrier's P&C-side reserve estimates in the Actuarial value stream. Extracts paid and incurred loss transactions by accident period, builds cumulative paid, incurred, and count development triangles, screens for anomalies, and reconciles triangle totals to the general ledger and claims system. Compiles loss triangles by accident year, derives IBNR as ultimate less paid and case reserves using chain ladder, Bornhuetter-Ferguson, and frequency-severity methods, and calculates unearned premium reserves from in-force policies. Manages the ceded side by mapping treaty terms to affected reserve segments and reconciling ceded reserves to Schedule F, performs quarterly actual-versus-expected analysis on reserve development, and prepares Schedule P and statutory exhibits supporting the actuarial opinion.

profiles.description: Second-line compliance manager in Market Conduct & Consumer who owns market conduct oversight across sales, call center, and business operations value streams. Designs the market conduct risk assessment and annual monitoring plan, maps conduct obligations to business activities across product lines, and builds risk-based compliance testing plans and sampling schedules. Runs the consumer complaint lifecycle — determining jurisdictional acknowledgment deadlines, validating allegations against policy terms and regulation, compiling the complaint register, and mapping complaint data to NAIC and state reporting codes. Also screens recommendations against Reg BI suitability rules, maintains the advertising review log and approved materials register, captures marketing consent and TCPA status controls, and supports state market conduct examinations.

Broad six-value-stream footprint is unusual but consistent with a conduct function that oversees all consumer-facing operations.

profiles.description: Analyst in the Marketing department who leads market and industry analysis for the Sales Distribution Marketing value stream and supports Product Delivery opportunity assessment. Gathers market sizing and industry premium data, maps company market share against the addressable market, and participates in sizing the addressable market and premium pool for new product opportunities. Runs competitive intelligence — collecting competitor product, rate, and rate-filing data and issuing alerts to sales and product teams — and supports brand strategy by defining positioning and value propositions by customer segment and tracking brand awareness and perception metrics over time. Contributes segmentation and persona models that map customer segments to preferred buying channels, and forecasts campaign reach, response, and acquisition cost for campaign planning.

profiles.description: Leads marketing execution for the Sales Distribution Marketing value stream, owning the demand funnel from lead qualification criteria by line of business through segmented nurture journeys and prioritized conversion-improvement actions.
